page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a storage-focused instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 CPU operating at 2.5 GHz with 16 dedicated vCPUs and 64 GB of system memory, providing 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. A defining hardware characteristic is its bundled local HDD capacity of 47244 GB, combined with a 6 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile.

The hardware configuration utilizes dedicated x86_64 computing resources paired with high-capacity local magnetic storage rather than solid-state drives. While this provides exceptionally high local storage density for massive data sets, sequential and random I/O latency reflect standard mechanical hard drive characteristics. The 6 Gbps network interface supports moderate cluster communication and data ingest rates.

By offering extensive local magnetic storage capacity directly attached to dedicated vCPUs, ecs.d1.4xlarge provides a high storage-to-compute ratio without relying on external block storage services. This makes it a cost-efficient architecture for capacity-demanding tasks where ultra-low disk latency is not required. Appropriate workloads include MapReduce clusters, distributed file systems, batch log processing, and data warehousing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.4xlarge is a high-density storage instance designed for data-intensive processing tasks. Powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, it provides 16 dedicated vCPUs, 64 GB of RAM, and a 6 Gbps baseline network interface. Its primary feature is a massive 47244 GB local HDD storage array, delivering high capacity directly on the host instance. The balanced vCPU-to-memory allocation paired with high local storage density makes this virtual server efficient for processing large volumes of data where extreme storage IOPS are not critical. The instance is suited for big data analytics, distributed file systems, batch log processing, and data warehousing workloads.
